result.title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
result.summary: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AdProducer，一个端到端 agentic 广告视频生成框架：多模态 agent 通过网络与图像检索调研产品，生成卖点驱动的分镜脚本以驱动冻结的视频生成器，并用 SFT 加强化学习（分镜级与视频级联合奖励）训练，同时发布 AdCreation-Bench 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先检索产品证据、再决定分镜呈现」的主动信息获取流程，以及为中间分镜表示单独设置奖励的分层监督，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与中间状态贡献分配提供启发线索，尚需核查中间表示是否真正承载并影响最终输出，故相关性较间接。
